'''Ryan Lynch''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Belle Mead tournament]] on 29 April 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|COTVG]], according to Greg Shaw's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2214">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-01-dwarf-invasion-belle-mead-nj-4-29d2214/ dwarf-invasion-belle-mead-nj-4-29], DeckTech (Greg "TychoCelchu" Shaw, 1 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-01-dwarf-invasion-belle-mead-nj-4-29d2214/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
